title: Jessica Utts statistical analysis of CIA Stargate psychic spying

tellings.quote: Jessica Us uh the statistician studying all the sort of you know psychic spy Stargate stuff coming out coming out of the CIA it does seem like a lot of these things fall way below you know p values that you'd expect

plain: The CIA's psychic spying research, known as Stargate, which tested whether people could see distant places with the mind, is said to have produced results far too good to be chance. Michels tells this from the work of the statistician Jessica Utts, who studied the programme's data, and says the results "fall way below" the p values, the odds of a fluke, that you would expect. If true, it would mean psychic spying actually worked.
